definitions.ask: Should the sub-project map also skip _conflicts/ copies, so ^prj cascades never write into them?
definitions.why: bob-cli's project scan already skips _conflicts/; the plugin should agree

choices.label: Filter buildProjectChildrenMap too; plugin cascade matches bob projects sync
Fix only the pickers; a sub-project's conflict copy can still get cascade writes

definitions.ask: Should Open child note also hide _generated/ notes, like the two dev_links query pages?
definitions.why: Only _conflicts/ was requested; generated query pages can be handy children

choices.label: Hide _generated/ children too; only hand-authored child notes are listed
Keep listing them; only _conflicts/ copies disappear
